summary: Backend-only testing for Restaurant Digital QR Menu Maker SaaS. Executed 26 pytest test cases covering health, plans catalog, admin auth (seeded credentials), owner registration/login/me, password forgot+reset (via server logs), owner CRUD (restaurant profile, categories, items, tables), public restaurant + QR scan increment, public order creation with WhatsApp URL, owner analytics (scans/orders/items/categories/tables/trend/popular), AI description via Emergent LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.6), file upload to Emergent Object Storage + retrieval, admin stats/users/plan/status/suspend-blocks-login, owner cannot access admin, and cascade delete. All 26 tests PASS.

minor.issue: Reset token is only surfaced via server logs (INFO log). Fine for MVP but no email delivery. Documented in credentials file, but consider returning token in dev mode or persisting in a way testable via admin API.
put_object uses synchronous `requests` inside an async handler (blocks event loop). Same for /api/files/{path}. Consider httpx AsyncClient or run in threadpool.
No brute-force lockout (auth playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts). Not implemented.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Should be explicit origin list for production.

action_items: Optional: replace synchronous `requests` calls in put_object/get_object with async httpx to avoid blocking FastAPI event loop.
Optional: implement brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login per auth playbook.
Optional: tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit list when moving to production (credentials + wildcard is invalid).
Optional: expose password reset token via admin/dev endpoint or email integration; currently only in server logs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 849 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, owner, admin, public, files, ai) for maintainability.
put_object/get_object are blocking (sync requests) inside async endpoints — will hurt concurrency under load.
make_slug replaces every non-alphanumeric char with '-' which converts unicode/accented restaurant names into hyphen-heavy slugs; consider slugify library.
Admin login endpoint does NOT check status==suspended (only role check) — an admin marked suspended could still login. Minor since admin isn't suspendable via UI, but tighten anyway.
unique_slug races: two concurrent registers with same restaurant_name could both pass the lookup then both insert; slug index will raise DuplicateKeyError uncaught (500).
Owner analytics popular list uses o['items'][i]['name'] without existence check; if an order item lacks 'name' it will KeyError.
No pagination on /api/admin/users, /api/orders, /api/items — capped at 500/2000 with .to_list(); OK for MVP but flag.
test_credentials: Admin: aadilrandhnpara12@gmail.com / Admin@12345 (working). Owner accounts created dynamically per-test with TEST_owner_<hex>@example.com prefix.
seed_data_creation: Each test session creates one owner account + restaurant + category + item + table + orders + scans, then cascade-deletes via admin API in the final cleanup test. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist with LoadScopeScheduling (class-level workers). It reads /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log to fetch the password reset token (server logs it via logger.info). Email is lowercased before insertion, so log grep must use email.lower(). All endpoints prefixed with /api. Frontend not tested per E1's request.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing endpoints. All 12 requested backend feature areas verified end-to-end including AI (Claude Sonnet 4.6) and Emergent Object Storage upload+download.
